title: Collecting iterators before immediate iteration
summary: Using collect() to materialize an intermediate Vec when the iterator could be consumed lazily.
rationale: Intermediate collections increase allocation, memory pressure, and cache churn.

detection.notes: Detect collect() followed by immediate iteration, map, filter, count, or fold.

impact.notes: Impact increases in hot paths, large inputs, high-concurrency services, build pipelines, or repeated request paths.

remediation.guidance: Keep operations lazy with iterator chains, fold, for_each, or streaming adapters.
remediation.tradeoffs: Materialization can be appropriate when reuse, sorting, indexing, or ownership isolation is required.
